# MarrowQ experiment report
**Experiment:** `exp_3b76f53a` · **Dataset:** UCI Bone Marrow Transplant: Children (N=187) · **Completed:** None · **Runtime:** 0.0 s

## Question
Can pre-transplant information predict: Neutrophil engraftment (ANC > 0.5×10⁹/L) by Day +14.

## Data
- Patients analysed: 0; class counts {}.
- Predictors (11): `cd34_dose`, `cd3_dose`, `cd34_cd3_ratio`, `stem_cell_source`, `recipient_age`, `recipient_body_mass`, `donor_age`, `hla_match`, `disease`, `high_risk`, `second_transplant`.

## Method
- Classical models: Single stratified train/test split.
- Quantum-kernel SVM: features compressed by training-fold PCA to one per qubit, ZZ feature map, fidelity kernel; evaluated on a single held-out split (test fraction 0.25).
- All preprocessing (imputation, log transform of skewed doses, scaling, encoding) is fitted on training data only.

## Results
| Model | ROC-AUC (95% CI) | Balanced accuracy | Brier | N evaluated | Scope |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| No models trained | | | | | |

## Findings
- No scored models.

## Limitations
- Single-centre paediatric cohort (UCI, n = 187); performance may not transfer to adults or other centres.
- Associations are not causal effects. Research prototype; not for clinical decision-making.

## Data source
Sikora M, Wróbel Ł, Gudyś A. Bone marrow transplant: children. UCI Machine Learning Repository, 2020. doi:10.24432/C5NP6Z
